content.title: Masters purse 2026: Prize money breakdown, how much does winner get?
content.text: Updated April 11, 2026, 8:54 p.m. ETFollow along for live coverage from the third round of the Masters.It's often said that winning the Masters is one of the most cherished and coveted wins in a golfer's career.It's a win that not only gives them a spot in golf immortality, but a win in Augusta also gives them that coveted green jacket to wear around the grounds at the Augusta National Golf Club, a spot in the Champions locker room and a lifetime invitation to Augusta National each April.But it's also one that comes with a rather nice payday for the winner, as they receive the largest share from the Masters purse, which will once again be a record-setting payout for the 2026 Masters Tournament.The tournament announced on Saturday, April 11 that this year's Masters' purse will total $22.5 million, which is an increase of $1.5 million from last season's purse. The winner will take home $4.5 million of the purse, an increase of $300,000 from what Rory McIlroy took home last year.Speaking of McIlroy, the 2025 winner entered Saturday's third round looking to separate himself even more from the field to become the first back-to-back Masters champion since Tiger Woods in 2001 and 2002.Those who did not make Friday's cut will receive $25,000 from the purse.Here's what the purse is at the 90th Masters Tournament this season:2026 Masters purseThe total prize money for professionals competing in the 2026 Masters is $22.5 million, up from $21 million in 2025.Masters 2026 winner prize moneyThe winner of the 2026 Masters at Augusta National will take home a record $4.5 million in prize money.Here's how much recent winners have earned – in addition to the green jacket.2025 winner's share: $4.2 million (Rory McIlroy)2024 winner's share: $3.6 million (Scottie Scheffler)2023 winner's share: $3.24 million (Jon Rahm)2022 winner's share: $2.7 million (Scottie Scheffler)2021 winner's share: $2.07 million (Hideki Matsuyama)2020 winner's share: $1.8 million (Dustin Johnson)Masters prize money 2026: Payout breakdown1st$4,500,00026th$180,0002nd$2,430,00027th$173,2503rd$1,530,00028th$166,5004th$1,080,00029th$159,7505th$900,00030th$153,0006th$810,00031st$146,2507th$753,75032nd$139,5008th$697,50033rd$132,7509th$652,50034th$127,12510th$607,50035th$121,50011th$562,50036th$115,87512th$517,50037th$110,25013th$472,50038th$105,75014th$427,50039th$101,25015th$405,00040th$96,75016th$382,50041st$92,25017th$360,00042nd$87,75018th$337,50043rd$83,25019th$315,00044th$78,75020th$292,50045th$74,25021st$270,00046th$69,75022nd$252,00047th$65,25023rd$234,00048th$61,65024th$216,00049th$58,50025th$198,00050th$56,700The USA TODAY app gets you to the heart of the news — fast.
